summary_en: The caller, Kiran, initiated the call but stated he was currently busy and requested a callback for the next day at 6 PM. The agent explained that they could not schedule a callback directly but offered to arrange an in-person clinic appointment at that time instead, asking for the reason for the visit. The caller confirmed he wanted the callback on the same number and provided his name as Kiran. After the agent noted these details and asked again about the issue, the caller simply said 'Okay, thank you,' and the call concluded with the agent confirming that the details and callback request were recorded.
next_action: Agent to inform the front desk to contact Kiran for a clinic appointment at 6 PM tomorrow.
objections: Caller was busy and requested a callback instead of an immediate appointment.
notes: Agent explicitly refused to schedule a callback but offered to pass the request to the front desk for an in-person appointment. The caller agreed to this alternative.

lead_assessment.note: Priority score uses recorded business signals; it is not a conversion probability or contact consent.
